label: UNAME_R
argv: ( uname -r ); rc=$?; printf '\nRC=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_UNAME_R; else echo FAIL_UNAME_R; fi

label: UNAME_M
argv: ( uname -m ); rc=$?; printf '\nRC=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_UNAME_M; else echo FAIL_UNAME_M; fi

label: OS_RELEASE
argv: ( cat /etc/os-release ); rc=$?; printf '\nRC=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_OS_RELEASE; else echo FAIL_OS_RELEASE; fi

label: GLIBC
argv: ( rpm -q glibc ); rc=$?; printf '\nRC=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_GLIBC; else echo FAIL_GLIBC; fi

label: MEMINFO
argv: ( cat /proc/meminfo ); rc=$?; printf '\nRC=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_MEMINFO; else echo FAIL_MEMINFO; fi

label: UID
argv: ( id -u ); rc=$?; printf '\nRC=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_UID; else echo FAIL_UID; fi

label: GOVERNORS
argv: ( for n in 0 1 2 3; do p=/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu$n/cpufreq/scaling_governor; test -w "$p" || exit 1; cat "$p" || exit 1; done ); rc=$?; printf '\nRC=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_GOVERNORS; else echo FAIL_GOVERNORS; fi

label: WORKDIR
argv: ( test -d /opt/usr && test -w /opt/usr && if [ -d /opt/usr/glibc_memopt ]; then ls -la /opt/usr/glibc_memopt; test -z "$(ls -A /opt/usr/glibc_memopt)"; else echo ABSENT; fi ); rc=$?; printf '\nRC=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_WORKDIR; else echo FAIL_WORKDIR; fi

label: PROCESSES
argv:
( for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do test -r "$p/comm" || continue; printf '%s	' "${p##*/}"; tr '
' ' ' <"$p/comm"; printf '	'; tr '\000' ' ' <"$p/cmdline" 2>/dev/null; printf '
'; done ); rc=$?; printf '
RC=%s
' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_PROCESSES; else echo FAIL_PROCESSES; fi

label: TCP
argv: ( cat /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6 ); rc=$?; printf '\nRC=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_TCP; else echo FAIL_TCP; fi

label: SPACE
argv: ( df -k / /opt/usr ); rc=$?; printf '\nRC=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_SPACE; else echo FAIL_SPACE; fi

label: MEMPS
argv: ( command -v memps ); rc=$?; printf '\nRC=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_MEMPS; else echo FAIL_MEMPS; fi

label: GDB_STATE
argv: ( rpm -q gdb; command -v gdb; true ); rc=$?; printf '\nRC=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_GDB_STATE; else echo FAIL_GDB_STATE; fi

label: UPTIME
argv: ( date -u; uptime; cat /proc/loadavg ); rc=$?; printf '\nRC=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_UPTIME; else echo FAIL_UPTIME; fi

label: HEALTH_READONLY
argv: ( cat /sys/block/zram0/mm_stat; cat /proc/swaps; dmesg ); rc=$?; printf '\nRC=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_HEALTH_READONLY; else echo FAIL_HEALTH_READONLY; fi
